Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

1. Scope — Prescribes manufacturing details and other requirements of two varieties of hair belting yarn. 

2. Manufacture 

2.1 Variety 1 shall be evenly spun from 100 percent wool and Variety 2 shall be spun from a blend of 
minimum of 75 percent wool with a maximum of 25 percent stretched nylon fibres. 

2.2 The recommended fineness of wool and stretched nylon fibres to be used for the manufacture of 
hair belting yarn, is given below. 

2*2.1 Wool — Average fibre fineness between 35 and 45 microns. 

2.2.2 Nylon — Fineness between 4 to 6 denier. 

3. Requirements — See Table 1.

4. Package — The yarn shall be made into hanks, cones or cheeses. 

5. Marking — Each yarn package shall be marked with the following: 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Variety No. and Ref ISS 1721; 

c) Manufacturer's name, initials or trade-mark; and 

d) Weight of the package.

IS: 1721 -1970 
6. Packing 

6.1 The yarn shall be packed in conformity with the procedure laid down in IS : 32-1963* or IS : 741- 
1 962f, as the case may be. 

6.2 The case shall be marked with the following: 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Gross weight; 

c) Net weight; and 

d) Name of the manufacturer, initials or trade-mark. 

6.2.1 The yarn may also be marked with the ISI Certification Mark. Details are available from the 
Indian Standards Institution.
